Alright. Well, this is Pokemon Battlegrounds. I'm sure you're wondering, "what's that exactly?"
I figured as much. Let's just get to the point.
Basically, it's a simulated stadium for you to experiment and battle your Pokemon. You can do this alone or even with a friend.
That's right, this game supports couch co-op play, similar to the Stadium titles.
Unlike the Stadium titles, we do not have charming 3D models for our little creatures. Yeah...
On the bright side, this simulation is so lightweight, you can even have people join in from their phone if they want! Cool, right? (This feature isn't actually available yet. SORRY!)
Besides this, it's just your run of the mill battle simulator. Use your Pokemon how you wish, with only your self-imposed restrictions.
